{{Quote|Good hunting, and may the Force be with you.|Mavra Zane to the Padawans|<ref name="Kinect" />}}
A '''trihexalon-based attack''' was launched against the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]].

==Prelude==
The [[trihexalon]] plot was launched by [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] leader [[Shu Mai/Legends|Shu Mai]]<ref name="Kinect" /> around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]]<ref name="Attack" /> in order to eliminate the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] on the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The [[Subjugator-class heavy cruiser/Legends|Heavy Cruiser]] [[Subjugator (Subjugator-class)|''Subjugator'']] carried the biological weapon aboard. A [[Rebellion on Felucia|rebellion]] on her fortress-world [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]] forced her to launch the attack.<ref name="Kinect" />

==The attack==
The ''Subjugator'' and her escorts arrived at Coruscant and faced the defensive [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]], a large number of [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-clas Star Destroyers]]. The Star Destroyers were also assisted by [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] [[Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptors]]. Additional reinforcements from both sides arrived during the battle. [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] ordered [[Gold Squadron (Galactic Republic)/Legends|Gold Squadron]] to take down the ''Subjugator's'' shields. They succeeded, and [[Mavra Zane]]'s [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] were able to fly inside the ship and destroy its reactor, destroying it and ending the Trihexalon threat.<ref name="Kinect" />

==Aftermath==
The Padawans were promoted to [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knighthood]] at a ceremony in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]].<ref name="Kinect" />

==Behind the scenes==
The attack appears in the Jedi Destiny portion of the [[2012]] [[Wikipedia:Kinect|Kinect]]-exclusive [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Kinect Star Wars]]''.
